children: About $500 bln of data-center debt has been issued this year already, but lender pricing and protections tell another part of the demand tale. Risk is recalibrating fastest for borrowers awaiting permits and power. The safety-to-speculation spread will only keep growing.
Full view will be published shortly.

Blue Owl Capital said on August 28 that it led a $2.4 billion financing package for an IREN artificial intelligence data center campus in Canada, in one of the latest debt issues that have been flooding the market.
The $1.2 billion senior secured term loan and $1.2 billion of senior secured notes will fund purchases of Nvidia compute equipment.
